chapter_title: Concerning the Fifteen Paths; and whether the Cate
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶2:**

Fifteen distinct
 states
 of spiritual progression are differentiated within
 the intermediate realm of the mind, where
 celestial and infernal infl
ux
 meet. Four of
 these states are pure and belong to divine
 wisdom
;
 they lead
 the
 soul directly into
 conjunction
 with the Divine Life
. Eight further
 states are mixed —
 conditions
 in
 which wisdom and falsity remain
 intermingled.
 Through these, whatever
 is truly
 of
 wisdom
 may
 still
 ascend and be liberated;
 it
 is purified and received into the doc
trinal forms that carry understanding
 toward the celestial kingdom
. But
 what
 is false
 and evil within
 those
 mixed
 states is separated out and cast down
 into the
 rest
less cycling
 of the
 unre
generate will
,
 perpet
ually turning
 through
 di
sor
dered states without
 resolution
. And
 the remaining
 three states are
 wholly
 given
 over to what
 is false
 and evil, and
 they discharge
 the
 soul
 into
 spiritual
 devastation.

**¶3
:**
These
 three states of devast
ation originate from the proprium —
 from
 all
 that the
 soul
 derives
 from
 itself
 rather
 than from the Divine. The
 first is the l
ust of the self-will against divine
 order, which operates in every
 person and
 in all that belongs
 to the self
-life
. The second is the destruction
 of charity
 —
 the violence
 by
 which every
 good
 affection is consumed and ann
ihilated within
 the natural mind. The third is prof
anation:
 the active violation of divine truth where
 it suf
fers and bears within the natural realm
,
 together with all
 fals
ification
 of
 doctrine
 and des
ecration that
 wounds the divine qualities themselves.

**
¶4:**
These three states
,
 it
 is taught, lead into
 spiritual devastation. And
 every soul proceeds
 according to the quality of its interior life
 —
 either
 toward conjunction with the Divine,
 or toward spiritual death.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: You have explained [that the three] paths that belong to waste, the ones that are drawn to the gehennas, [a]re drawn from the fleshes. O[n]e of them is the appetite for [lawl]essness, that of people and of all flesh. The second is the [wrath against] all bodies, which is slaughter, [with] which all flesh is consumed. The third is the damaging action, which [defiles] the Cross of Light and every body; together with the rest of the error and the blasphemy that wounds the gods.
Th[ese th]ree paths have you taught us, that they lead to the gehennas. And you have also [told] us that every person shall follow after hi[s] de[e]ds, whether to life or indeed to death.

For we have heard thus from you: ‘Fifteen paths are drawn out in the zone. Four paths are pure and belong [to the] light, leading up to life. Eight other paths are [mixed], leading above from that place. The light shall go [u]p and become free through them; be purified and go in [to the] ships. However, the waste is separated and thrown [dow]n to transmigr[a]tion and the other three paths of [waste ...] discharged to the gehennas’.
